objective: Gate4E-R1 minimo. Auditar solo metadatos y definiciones reales para identificar la semantica comercial exacta de Customer360 sin asumir nombres de columnas. No ejecutar agregaciones dependientes de columnas desconocidas. No modificar vistas, tablas, codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: g4e_r1_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: g4e_r1_venta_encabezado_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Encabezado') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r1_venta_estatus_object
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Estatus') AS object_id,CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Estatus') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exists_flag

queries.name: g4e_r1_venta_estatus_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Estatus') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r1_operational_date_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fecha%oper%' OR LOWER(c.name) IN ('fechaoperacion','fecha_operacion','fecha_operativa')) ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r1_comercial_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%comercial%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%kpi%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%venta%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r1_activity_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r1_customer360_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360') ORDER BY c.column_id
